purpose: Implementation-neutral normalized clinical projections used by Swift, Kotlin, and TypeScript producer CI. These vectors contain no source business identity and execute no producer implementation.
comparisonRule: Compare exactly profile, code, effective, and result after removing adapter lineage/context. Every Mobile scalar or aggregate effective endpoint is first rounded to the nearest millisecond with ties to even, then serialized with the caller/source numeric UTC offset when available; Sensor and ECG SampledData timing is excluded. Parse offset-bearing FHIR endpoints without precision loss, require the emitted endpoint already to be millisecond-canonical, and normalize equal instants to the vector representation. Compare the remaining projection using RFC 8785/JCS JSON. Adapter context is admitted only by the referenced closed sourceContextRules and is not part of the source-neutral clinical projection.
